title: Sensor Systems, Thresholds, and Testing
prerequisites: Identify input, process, and output in a simple system
Read a sensor value and evaluate a comparison condition
objectives: Trace an ultrasonic input through threshold logic, a Bluetooth signal, and a sound output.
Predict results below, at, and above a threshold.
Record expected and actual results in a repeatable test table.
Use test evidence to identify and retest one likely correction.
evidence: Saved system plan, boundary rule, test plan, and fallback description

requirements.software: MakeCode and assigned micro:bit hardware, or the labeled simulator fallback
requirements.account: No account required for module practice
requirements.storage: Progress remains in this browser and device
requirements.offline: Use printed system diagrams, threshold tables, and test records. A labeled paper simulation replaces unavailable hardware.

formalAssessment: Separate teacher directions and rubric are required.
